contexts.text: Fat () = celestial life.
Fat of the kidneys of wheat () = the Celestial of love and charity; and as fat, or fat, = what is celestial...
The fat of lambs () = the charity of innocence.
They did eat the fat of the sacrifices () = they destroyed the good of worship.
The fat of My feast shall not pass the night even to the morning ();- the good of worship not from proprium, but from the Lord always new.
Fat, or fat = the good of love. References.
Thou shalt take all the fat () = good accommodated.
The two kidneys and the fat upon them () = the interior truth of the external man, and the good thereof.
The reason all the fat was to be burned upon the altar... was that it = Divine good.
That fat, or fat = Divine good. Illustrated.
Therefore the Israelitish people were utterly forbidden to eat fat and blood. AC 10040.
Thou shalt take the fat from the ram () = good in the Heavens.
The fat covering the intestines () = good in ultimates.
Fat = the good of love. AE 365:36. AE 374:12.
As the fat in the sacrifices = the Divine good... they were forbidden to eat it. Explained. AE 617:23. AE 1159:4.
The fat of the mighty () = evils overcome and dissipated.
Fat = celestial good.
Fat = interior goods.
The fat of wheat = the delight of spiritual good.
These were partly represented by the fats which were sacrificed from the bullock and from the second goat.
To satisfy the soul with fat and fat () = to be filled with the good of love and the joy thence derived.
